# Agent-Crypto legacy one-shot workflows

Archived on 2026-09-22 during the GitHub hygiene audit.

These workflow definitions were version-specific release, presentation, Aether, delivery, or audit workflows whose current trigger was bounded to a push touching the workflow file itself. They are preserved here as source history while being removed from the active .github/workflows surface.

They are **not current release owners** and GitHub Actions must not execute files from this archive directory.

Current generic workflows remain under .github/workflows.
Four versioned workflows with non-self trigger files were intentionally left active pending a separate trigger audit:
- agent-crypto-40-4-107-patch.yml
- agent-crypto-40-4-131-patch.yml
- agent-crypto-406086-version-authority-consolidation.yml
- agent-crypto-406086-version-owner-lock.yml

Historical commits remain the authoritative recovery path for exact old execution state.
